subject: general
question: A and C are sisters. A is the daughter of D. D is the mother of B. How is A related to B?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854e449acd75259b0fdb6ee8f851931989fac9f98d9eedc211a9f6a75ae54a7d.png] 

Explanation:

1) A and C are sisters.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b17e7e857909ce53b283450094f0d03e1375bb6046729950a4756fecd2e8438a.png] 

2) A is the daughter of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d9a029f368516b61c2757262a4db832969cb355f356583eafc0da5c4403a71b.png] 

3) D is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df9889d0a811293fd3dac36309a67631ba17c2cdfa9a417a82dafe5980b9d1f1.png] 

So, A is the sister of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
